notes.claim: To find the distance between two points on a grid, draw a right triangle as when finding slope, then use Pythagoras for the hypotenuse.
The distance formula is derived from the Pythagorean theorem and finds the distance between two points in the plane.
Each coordinate of the midpoint is the average of the matching coordinates of the two points.
